metrics.name: Verdict and recommendation consistency
metrics.criteria: Determine whether the recommendation accurately reflects every deterministic acceptance-criterion label and rationale without changing or contradicting PASS, GAP, DEFECT, or RISK.
evaluation_steps: Check that the recommendation addresses every GAP, DEFECT, and RISK.
Check that it does not describe a deterministic PASS as a failure.
Score consistency and completeness; do not reinterpret the labels.

metrics.name: Evidence-grounded explanation
metrics.criteria: Determine whether the output makes only claims supported by the supplied deterministic rationale and evidence counts, and routes incomplete evidence to human review.
evaluation_steps: Identify the claims made by the recommendation.
Compare each claim with the supplied deterministic rationale and evidence count.
Penalize invented observations, unsupported certainty, or missing human-review guidance.
Score the degree to which the explanation stays grounded.
